purpose: Measure legality and direct-data Adam200 optimizability after reducing the compact axis-flipped prior radius to 0.12 m and relaxing only the coil curvature-p95 score scale to a 0.04 m characteristic radius.

start_representation.order: generate float64 analytic tokens, map to exact-unclipped float32 standardized data coordinates, reconstruct physical tokens, then screen and optimize those same reconstructed tokens

score_configuration.library_status: experiment-specific rebuild; SHA-256 is recorded after compute-node build
score_configuration.interpretation: Only the curvature-p95 scale changes from 10 to 25 inverse metres. The maximum-curvature term remains at 35 inverse metres so horn-like extremes retain the stricter guard.
score_configuration.all_other_native_score_terms: identical to ABI-11 default source at the frozen experiment commit

legality_audit.legal_definition: native status == ok on the exact optimizer-representable start
legality_audit.estimator: legal count divided by the precommitted 384-sample audit population
legality_audit.samples_after_the_fixed_audit: retained for optimizer completion accounting but excluded from the primary legality estimate

adam_selection.rule: Each worker sends its earliest legal samples to Adam until two trajectories complete. After that it finishes its 64-sample legality audit without starting more Adam trajectories.

optimizer.direction_policy: fresh random orthogonal directions per update

resources.slurm_limit: 8 hours as a runaway guard; expected completion is count-bounded

monitoring.screening: fixed-audit status counts, legal rate, score and coil component distributions
monitoring.adam200: initial/best/final total score, volume-QS, coil component, joint component changes, threshold counts, and trajectories

default_impact: none; the default ABI-11 library and qh-flow-screen32-adam200-64d-abi11-v1 remain unchanged
